caption: The drawing shows a single, detailed fireman’s helmet placed against a plain, beige background. The helmet is predominantly off-white or light grey with visible shading and signs of wear around the edges, which are outlined in darker, purplish tones. The helmet has a peaked crown with vertical ridges rendered in muted, greenish-grey and brown hues. At the front, there is a shield-shaped badge that is colored in red and brown tones, and raised details including the number "3" and the letters "ENGINE" and "H.V.S." can be seen. An ornamental gold eagle is perched at the top front of the badge. The inner lining underneath the brim is shaded in a purple hue. To the left of the helmet, the name "ELMER G ANDERSON" is printed in small, serif capital letters.
title: Fireman's Helmet
